name: git-workflows
description: Four Git skills that stay safe when several agent sessions share one repository: pull-latest, reset-to-remote, merge-and-clean-up, and publish-docs.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Git updates, merges, and document saves for shared repositories.
interface.longDescription: Four Git skills for repositories where several agent sessions work at once. pull-latest brings a checkout up to date without rebase, reset, or push. reset-to-remote makes the checkout an exact copy of its remote, only on the owner's explicit words. merge-and-clean-up merges an allowed pull request and removes only its branches and worktree. publish-docs commits and pushes an agreed document edit to the default branch from an isolated worktree.
defaultPrompt: Merge this pull request and clean up
